blocks.text: AWS Disaster Recovery as a Service (DRaaS)

We architect and deliver a fully managed Disaster Recovery-as-a-Service (DRaaS) on AWS, ensuring your mission-critical applications are always on, data will be in sync and protected, and your business is always ready for the unexpected.
Downtime is Not an Option. Hope is Not a Strategy

In a 24/7 economy, any disruption to your critical operations—whether from a site failure, a natural disaster, or a ransomware attack—can have devastating financial and reputational consequences. Leaders are asking: "How do we guarantee business continuity? How do we protect ourselves from modern threats? And how do we do it without the massive cost and complexity of a traditional, mirrored DR site?"

blocks.alt: 3 women sitting on chair in front of table with laptop computers

blocks.text: The Blueprint for Continuous Business Operations

Our approach is to architect a resilient, automated, and cost-effective DR strategy using the power of AWS Elastic Disaster Recovery (DRS). We design a solution that provides a warm, on-demand recovery site in the cloud, giving you enterprise-grade protection with a pay-as-you-go model. Our blueprint focuses on automated failover, regular non-disruptive testing, and a single pane of glass for managing your entire resilience posture.
We ensure block-level replication of your on-premise or cloud-based machines to a low-cost staging area in AWS, meeting the most demanding Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
